patch.value: GH-1051: package catalog rejects universal output-budget controls

GitHub issue #1051 reports that the read-only package --catalog mode is rejected when a generic caller supplies the universal output-budget recovery controls, even though the catalog is a complete read surface. Make command intent mode-sensitive so catalog accepts bounded/unbounded read controls while mutating package modes remain protected and discoverable through CLI/SDK contracts.
